_comment: Gemini CLI harness MCP scope for Starlight Orchestrator. Read-only across the whole substrate + connected verticals. Gemini's leverage is the 1M context window — surgical edits route to Claude Code primary. Built on SIP — see footer.
_loaded_when: 1M-context jobs, multi-repo cross-references, codebase-wide refactor planning, cross-vertical canon reconciliation, historical pattern surfacing
_write_policy: READ-ONLY across substrate. Single allowed write surface: core/orchestrator/intel/<date>-gemini-<topic>.md (summary / structural diff output).

starlight-substrate._purpose: substrate-wide read for long-context grokking — vaults, IS namespaces, attestation registry, memory graph, all 10 verticals

arcanea-mcp._purpose: Arcanea canon read for cross-vertical reconciliation work — Guardians, Vel'Tara archetypes, Passport flow
arcanea-mcp._status: scaffold — wire when Arcanea MCP server lands; Phase 1 dependency

_task_scoped_mcps._comment: Gemini's task-scoped MCPs are exclusively read-only / list / search verbs. The harness never carries write tools. Surgical edits route to Claude Code primary via core/orchestrator/intel/ summaries.

github_read._purpose: multi-repo log + diff read for cross-repo reconciliation
github_read._pattern: gh CLI read-only commands only (gh repo view, gh pr list, gh pr diff, gh pr view, gh release list, gh log)

google_drive_read._purpose: vault parity check — does Drive mirror match canonical markdown vault?

notion_read._purpose: Ops Hub history + cross-page pattern search

_secrets_policy._comment: Gemini never handles secrets. Long-context reads operate against public substrate + read-only mirrors of integrated systems. Any task that requires a token escalates to Claude Code primary.
